environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. Environment variable CRED_ROTATION_MS=60000 (60 second rotation). Task networking uses awsvpc mode with a security group that permits egress only to VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/8) and specific AWS service endpoints via VPC PrivateLink. The ECS task role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoIMDSBoundary) that denies sts:AssumeRole for any principal outside the account. The Fargate platform version 1.4.0 enforces IMDSv2 with a hop limit of 1 (container cannot reach task metadata via redirect). Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule that inspects the Host header and drops requests where the query string parameter 'url' contains RFC 1918 addresses or link-local (169.254.x.x) patterns via a custom regex rule (priority 1, action: fixed-response 403). Credential rotation at 60s means any intercepted X-Internal-API-Secret or X-Internal-API-Key expires before an attacker can replay it against internal services.

config.network: awsvpc mode, egress SG allows only 10.0.0.0/8 and VPC endpoints
config.imds: IMDSv2 enforced, hop limit 1 (unreachable from container)
config.alb_rule: Listener rule priority 1: if query_string 'url' matches '(169\.254|10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])|192\.168)' then fixed-response 403
config.egress_filtering: Security group denies egress to 0.0.0.0/0, allows only 10.0.0.0/8 and pl-xxxxxxxx (S3, DynamoDB endpoints)
